title: Reviews

list.searchPartial: {found} · search covers the {shown} loaded of {total} reviews
list.pageLimit: The page shows at most {limit} reviews; narrow the filters to reach the others.
list.nothingToReplyBody: Every stored review has a reply or a saved draft.
list.noFilterMatchesBody: Nothing stored matches the selected rating, version, period and reply state.
list.noStoredBody: Reviews appear after the next daily sync.
list.searchBody: Search looks through the titles, texts, authors and replies of the reviews loaded here.
list.quotedSearchBody: A search in quotes matches whole words in the titles and texts of the reviews loaded here.
list.replyStatusSummary: Needs reply: no reply anywhere. Draft: a reply is kept here and not marked. Replied: the store shows a reply, posted from here or in the console, or you marked the review as replied. Updated: the reviewer edited the review after the Google Play reply, so read it again.

toolbar.nothingToExport: Nothing to export: no review matches this search
toolbar.exportTitle: Exports the {order} {limit} reviews that match the filters

lede.newCapped: {count} or more new {count, plural, one {review} other {reviews}}
lede.noStored: No reviews or ratings are stored yet. They are read on the daily run.

ratings.averageOf: Average of {count, plural, one {# rating} other {# ratings}}
ratings.noHistoryBody: The daily pipeline stores the number of ratings with each snapshot.
ratings.shortHistory: Daily bars need a few more daily snapshots.
ratings.distributionFailed: Could not load the ratings distribution.
ratings.versionAria: v{version}, {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}, average rating {average}{grade}
ratings.fromNewest: From the {loaded} newest of {total, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}
ratings.fromAll: From all {total, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}

mentions.title: What people mention
mentions.detail: in {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}}, {negative} at {stars, plural, one {# star} other {# stars}} or less
mentions.footer: From {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} matching the filters
mentions.failed: Could not load what people mention.
mentions.summary: Complaints come up mostly in reviews at {stars, plural, one {# star} other {# stars}} or less, praise mostly in the others, compared with the newest {baseline} reviews of the version and period. Counts cover the {counted} matching the filters. Pick one to list the reviews it counts.

goal.title: Ratings goal
goal.targetHint: Enter a target from {min} to {max} with at most one decimal.
goal.daysHint: Enter a whole number of days from {min} to {max}.
goal.intervalPace: about one every {count, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}
goal.first: With no ratings yet, the first five-star rating shows {target}.
goal.oneMore: To show {target} you need 1 more five-star rating.
goal.more: To show {target} you need {count} more five-star ratings, {pace} for {days, plural, one {# day} other {# days}}.
goal.assumes: Assumes every new rating is five stars and that the store shows one decimal.
goal.playWeight: Google Play gives recent ratings more weight, so read this as a rough guide.
goal.thinSample: With fewer than {count} ratings the average moves a lot with each new one.

composer.placeholder: Write the reply the store will show under this review
composer.cleared: Emptying the field keeps the saved reply. Press Discard to remove it.
composer.discardDescription: The text and the replied mark kept for this review are removed. {notice}
composer.copyFailed: Couldn't copy — select and copy it manually

draftControls.instructionsPlaceholder: Instructions (optional), e.g. mention the new widgets
draftControls.shortened: Shortened to fit {store}'s {limit} characters; read it before you copy.

guidelines.title: Reply guidelines
guidelines.description: Every AI draft for this app follows these lines: who signs, the support address, what never to promise.
guidelines.placeholder: Sign as the Tomato team. Support: help@example.com. Never promise a release date.
guidelines.saveFailed: Could not save the reply guidelines

post.title: Post this reply publicly?
post.description: AsoBeast sends this text to {console} as the reply to this review.

withdraw.title: Withdraw this response?
withdraw.description: Apple removes it within a day. The text stays here.

exportNotice: Exported the {order} {counted} reviews. Narrow the filters to reach the others.
exportSearchNotice: Exported {count, plural, one {# review} other {# reviews}} found in the {order} {counted}. Narrow the filters to search the others.

storeAccess.playCannotRemove: Google Play offers no way to remove a reply through its API. Edit it here and post again, or remove it in Play Console.
storeAccess.oneReply: A review has one reply, so posting again replaces it.
storeAccess.noRatingAsk: Do not ask for a rating or offer anything in return.
storeAccess.withdrawn: Withdrawn from App Store Connect. Apple removes it within a day.
storeAccess.appStoreStays: The reply posted to App Store Connect stays there unless you withdraw it.
storeAccess.playStays: The reply posted on Google Play stays there.
storeAccess.playConsoleStays: A reply already posted in Play Console stays there.
storeAccess.connect: Connect {name} in Integrations to post replies from here.
storeAccess.rejectedError: {error} Until then, replies cannot be posted from here.
storeAccess.rejected: {name} refused the connected key. Verify it or connect a new one in Integrations to post replies.
storeAccess.ready: Posting sends this text to {console} with the key connected in Integrations.
storeAccess.publicRule: The reply is public under the review on {store}.
storeAccess.postedPending: Posted to App Store Connect. Apple publishes it within 24 hours.
storeAccess.discardConsole: A reply already posted in {console} stays there.
storeAccess.off: AsoBeast never writes to the store. Paste the reply in {console}.
storeAccess.alreadyShows: {store} already shows a reply. A new text here replaces it once posted.
